title: Publish went through with open required checklist steps (reported by the editing session, 2026-11-09)
description: The news desk editing session published a new post (typed with stories set-type, set-slug, saved with --images) while several required checklist steps (direction, research, review_*) were still not_done, even though publishing.publish_item calls require_checklist_closed. Reproduce on a throwaway story: which command published (papyrus ops content publish?), and whether the gate is skipped for posts, for new stories whose checklist template version differs (template version 3 added related_content), or when the checklist rows are state not_done rather than open (open_required only matches state OPEN?). Add a test that every publish path (ops content publish, the console, the content-actions handler) refuses with open required steps. Also: Markdown twin of posts printed 'By <author>' (core ignored an empty hook byline): PR #1349.
